ev.q: The percentage of homicide deaths that involved a firearm decreased with age, from 91.6% among those aged 10–24 years
the percentage of suicide deaths that involved a firearm was lowest among those aged 25–44 years (45.1%)

In 2020, approximately 8 in 10 homicides and 5 in 10 suicides in the United States involved firearms.
Persons aged ≥65 years had the highest percentage of suicide deaths that involved a firearm but the lowest percentage of homicide deaths
Source: National Vital Statistics System, Mortality Data, 2020.

methods_quotes.q: Firearm-involved suicide was identified using ICD-10 underlying cause-of-death codes X72–X74.
